why: A second adversarial set for the read scorer (scripts/lib/eval/read-score.js), from a round-2 review, reworded: copies of the line, absent or needed facts (contractions, lacks, missing, required, watch for, only after), wrong frames, hedges (should, may, unless), genuine own-words conflicts, the session sense of transition, stale negations. The line is the real frame-state format with two facts. `conflict`: own-words conflict expected (the State line shown); `stale`: the label called stale. `accepted`: a known miss kept as one, with its reason. `judgment`: a call a reader could make the other way.
